# UMC admission contract

## Ready for dated conditional operating-assets research
Original Atlas inventory: UMC, United Microelectronics, sectors 4/5. NYSE ADS and Robinhood availability verified. Ten audited fiscal years, ten completed guidance quarters, monthly revenue through September, original source provenance and independent replay are included.

**This is an operating-assets-only valuation. It excludes the entire nonoperating equity investment portfolio and circular-ownership benefit. Never label it total-company intrinsic value, full-company fair value, or a current target.**

## Adapter requirements
1. Start with `selected_policy = null` and require explicit selection. Do not auto-select the staged-bank example just because it produces funded values.
2. Keep `current_target = null` in headline tiles, comparisons, reverse DCF, exports and simulations. June shares/claims and June FX do not establish October capital after material convertible financing and cancellations.
3. Always display the June 30 capital/FX date, operating-assets/portfolio-exclusion scope, ex-declared-distribution basis, 5:1 ordinary/ADS ratio, and selected 67m authorized-share assumption.
4. Display only `conditional_usd_per_ads` or the correctly labeled TWD ordinary equivalent. Never expose `unfunded_mathematical_*` as an available valuation. Both all-bank-upfront and stress policies remain withheld; staged-bank cases pass the annual funding test only under their complete assumptions.
5. Staged policy values are approximately **$3.34 / $8.79 / $15.24 per ADS**, in bear/base/bull operating scenarios, using June 30 FX. They are neither current price targets nor a statistical confidence interval.
6. Never add book/quoted investment holdings to these outputs or shrink the denominator for cross-holdings without a separately reviewed circular ownership/tax model. The replay intentionally rejects a nonzero portfolio addback.
7. Preserve all deposit/dividend/tax/contract/refund/legacy reserves, sourced debt principal, lease normalization and funding-release timing. Do not deduct restricted employee shares twice; the 67m authorized new-share scenario is additional and separately identified.
8. Annual funding is not daily liquidity proof. The staged initial available balance is NT$10,999.935991m; the stricter all-bank-upfront policy fails by NT$489.988009m. Do not insert subsequent debt/equity proceeds to hide this gate.
9. The public bundle contains original analysis, facts, citations, hashes and replay code, with no raw issuer HTML/PDF/full transcripts. Source failures/HTTP403 captures are explicitly documented, not claimed as verified source bytes.
10. No Monte Carlo distribution is supplied or calibrated. Any later stochastic extension must retain this exclusion scope and replay every claim/funding gate; otherwise expose only the operating enterprise-value distribution.

The independently reviewed artifact is the admission unit. Any correction after freeze requires a new version. The research worker did not edit canonical Site/application files, publish, push or create accounts.
